name: winrestart-c-call
prompt:
In runner/src/main.rs, in the "self_update" job branch, right before the line `std::process::exit(4);` add two lines (WIN-RESTART):
`#[cfg(windows)]`
`setup::restart_task_later();`
(setup.rs defines it; the module is already declared as `mod setup;`). Also change the comment above that branch, `// RUNNER-SYNC: download, verify and swap in the newest runner, report, then exit so systemd (Linux) or the logon task (Windows) restarts it.`, to end with `then exit so systemd restarts it (Linux); on Windows it first schedules its logon task again (WIN-RESTART).` Change nothing else.
